title: Two years of payrolls, through the revision cycle
initial_vintage_rule: FRED output_type=4 initial-release realtime_start, cross-checked against the full snapshot on that date
missing_history: retain an explicit excluded row and reason; never substitute current observations
population: Every calendar month in 2023 and 2024, in chronological order; no selection by revision size
interpretation: Descriptive revision study. Latest means the fixed comparison information date. Monthly differences use two levels from the same vintage. Reference classifications are illustrative economic thresholds, not investment signals. Revisions include later benchmark and seasonal-factor updates; they are not pure measurement errors.
plan_stage: Exploratory historical study with a specification fixed before outcome calculation
